method.proof: Resolve the selected paths from both immutable commit roots, compare modes/types and Git blob IDs, and independently verify the complete commit compare has no intersection with the selected set.
method.content_identity: An identical Git blob object ID identifies the same file-content bytes under Git object-integrity assumptions. This is static source identity, not runtime observation.
method.subtree_listing_reuse: When both commit paths resolve to the same immutable subtree, list that object once and retain its complete untruncated entries for each selected file in both revisions.
method.source_of_metadata: Authorized GitHub plugin GETs of commit, Git-tree and compare endpoints; no local filesystem recovery.

selection.recipe: Select every blob recursively under the eight listed existing directory prefixes, add the ten explicit files, reject duplicates, sort by repository path. The six crate directories contribute 192 files; the control scope contributes 13 files.
selection.scope: Conservative tracked eval-library/local-dependency/runner input superset. Files such as crate documentation are included by whole-directory selection. Inclusion does not assert a file was compiled, executed, or exercised.

result.comparison_relation: 205 of 205 selected tracked input paths resolve to identical file modes, object types, Git blob IDs and Git-reported sizes.
